I have a PCL with entities to be shared between the backend and the frontend.
In order to use these entities in the frontend I want to take advantage of an observable collection. To avoid issues with the events raised by the observable collection during deserialization I created an additional array property. The code:
```C#
[IgnoreDataMember]
[JsonIgnore]
[NonSerialized]
public ObservableCollection<UserTenantEntity> TenantCollection { get; set; }
[DataMember]
public UserTenantEntity[] TenantArray { get; set; }
```
I was trying to make Orleans ignore the property TenantCollection (you can see IgnoreDataMember, JsonIgrnore, NonSerialized). But Orleans keeps producing in DeepCopier method this line:
```C#
result.@TenantCollection = (global::System.Collections.ObjectModel.ObservableCollection<global::Visible.Realm.UserTenantEntity>)global::Orleans.Serialization.SerializationManager.@DeepCopyInner(input.@TenantCollection);
```

When running the test I get this message:
```
Type 'Visible.Realm.UserTenantEntity' in Assembly 'RealmService.Entities, Version=1.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null' is not marked as serializable.
```
This message disappears if instead of using an ObservableCollection is used a List.

Is there any way to instruct Orleans not to serialize a property? 

Thank you,
Mauricio.
